evidence.claim: LEM produce trasduttori di corrente e tensione per trazione, rinnovabili, saldatura e auto, con stabilimenti a Pechino, Ginevra, Sofia, Tokyo e Penang.
evidence.quote: Its core products - current and voltage transducers - are used in a broad range of applications in drives & welding , renewable energies & power supplies , traction , high precision , conventional and green cars businesses. || It has production plants in Beijing (China), Geneva (Switzerland), Sofia (Bulgaria), Tokyo (Japan) and Penang (Malaysia).
